questions.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect correctly?
options: I have lost my keys yesterday.
I have lost my keys.
I lost my keys.
I had lost my keys.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form of the adjective 'happy'.
options: happier
more happy
happyer
most happy

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct modal verb: 'You _______ try studying a little more to pass the exam.'
options: should
must
can
would

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the gerund after the preposition 'enjoy'?
options: I enjoy swimming in the lake.
I enjoy to swim in the lake.
I enjoy swim in the lake.
I enjoy swimming at the lake.
questions.answer: I enjoy swimming in the lake.

questions.question: Select the sentence that uses the first conditional correctly.
options: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we stay at home.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the past continuous correctly?
options: I was sleeping when you called.
I slept when you called.
I had slept when you called.
I am sleeping when you called.
questions.answer: I was sleeping when you called.

questions.question: Choose the sentence with the correct use of 'since' and 'for'.
options: I have lived here since five years.
I have lived here for five years.
I have lived here since five years ago.
I have lived here for since five years.
questions.answer: I have lived here for five years.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'The weather is _______ today; we might need an umbrella.'
options: much colder than yesterday
more cold than yesterday
cold more than yesterday
colder than yesterday

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the infinitive after 'want'?
options: She wants to go to the cinema.
She wants going to the cinema.
She wants go to the cinema.
She wants to going to the cinema.
questions.answer: She wants to go to the cinema.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that uses the correct linker to show contrast.
options: It was raining, so we went out.
It was raining, but we went out.
It was raining, and we went out.
It was raining, therefore we went out.
questions.answer: It was raining, but we went out.
